items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Jenkins, he had talked to Herman Stark and them... Duke Ellington told Herman Stark and Owrey Madden to go over and hear this kid

ctx.x: No, but I was offered one. In fact they told me I could have one in the Cotton Club when they moved downtown. Now Duke was in there at the time, and Freddie Jenkins, he had talked to Herman Stark and them. He said, "Why don't you get a band together and we'll put you in as the relief band?"
